correctness.rationale: This passes the corrected RESULT.md, not the unqualified equivalence at frozen line 15. Homogeneous parity and mod-three tests annihilate 6 times every vector, but 6[T] is not in the lattice for any tritangent T; the frozen shorthand omitted a mod-four obstruction. The corrected conditions in Smith coordinates are exactly 20 independent mod-two tests and one mod-twelve test, the latter splitting as mod four and mod three. Independently generated the 45 planes from ordered exceptional-conic labels and perfect matchings, grouped disjoint triples by their nine-line supports and tested orthogonality of the two partitions (each cross intersection has one line). This recovers 120 distinct columns. Independently verified all Gram entries and its characteristic polynomial, which bound the prime support by 2 and 3, and used exact local elimination to compute 1^24, 2^20, 12. Adjoining each basis vector in turn lowered the index to 2^20, a factor of 12 each time. Also replayed the complete 2,710-operation data certificate with a separately written checked interpreter, verifying unimodularity and the rectangular diagonal. Thus the full-rank lattice, membership and individual-order claims of the corrected file hold.
residual_risks: Applies to geometric plane labels and the unsigned map on smooth cubics under the stated hypotheses, not descent, arbitrary singular cubics or torsion in a divisor-class group.
